recipes.name: Cold Busting Green Smoothie
instructions: To a blender, add the banana, apple, orange, cucumber, milk, spinach, parsley, and ginger. Blend on high until smooth.
Pour the smoothie into your desired glasses.
Sprinkle the smoothie with chia seeds, shake or stir the seeds in, and enjoy.

page_recipe_notes: Notes † Nutrition tip: aim to use plant-based milk that is fortified with calcium .
Storage Smoothies are best enjoyed immediately.
